take: Per Ottawa's announcement, the team recalled defenseman Donovan Sebrango from Belleville (AHL) and placed left winger Andre Burakovsky on injured reserve. Burakovsky had no points in five games, averaging 12.81 minutes, and the Senators controlled about 53 percent of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five when he played. Going by how the coach has used his players, Stephen Halliday, at 12:19 a night, is next in line for those minutes.
